hook: wait investors don't want the deck in the first email??

messages.text: Sent my full deck to a bunch of investors. Zero replies. What am I doing wrong?
You led with the deck. Most of us read the email first and decide fast.
So what do I send instead?
5 lines. What you do. Who pays. Traction. Why you. The ask.
Keep a short teaser deck ready. Send it when they reply asking for more.

cta: Save this before your next investor email.
caption:
Stop attaching a long deck to your first cold email. Investors get flooded with them. The email is the pitch. The deck comes later.

Write 5 lines:
1. What you do, in one sentence.
2. Who pays for it.
3. Your traction or proof so far.
4. Why your team wins.
5. The ask: a short call.

If they reply, send a short teaser deck. Save the full deck for the meeting.

No revenue yet? Show real signals: waitlist signups, pilot users, customer interviews. Something they can believe.

What's the first line of your investor email right now? Drop it below.
